listing.title: Authentic Hand-Painted Madhubani Painting on Handmade Paper
listing.description: This exquisite Madhubani painting is meticulously handcrafted on handmade paper using vibrant natural colors. Originating from the ancient Mithila region, this traditional art form features intricate geometric patterns and detailed depictions of folklore and nature, representing a rich cultural heritage preserved and passed down through generations of women artisans.
